name: @workspace/amynest-capacitor
description: Capacitor wrapper for AmyNest iOS (Xcode). Play Store Android uses android/ WebView wrapper, not this project.

scripts.sync:ios: npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-ios-capacitor-config.mjs && node scripts/patch-geolocation-ios.mjs
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:web && npm run patch:ios && npm run copy:ios-native && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-ios-capacitor-config.mjs && cd ios/App && pod install
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
